mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.15 percentage points signals monetary tightening, raising discount rates and depressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of joint decline instances, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.5%), a monthly unemployment rate decline signals labor market improvement, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 7.5 and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market strength, increasing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production (INDPRO) decline below 98.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 98.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In expansionary GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized), a positive GDP growth surprise (current quarter growth > previous quarter growth) signals robust economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized and current growth > previous growth
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3pp and stable FEDFUNDS (<= 0.15pp change) indicate the Fed is behind the curve on inflation, leading to higher real rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 1 month and FEDFUNDS unchanged (<= 0.15pp change)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp and FEDFUNDS is stable, or Rank IC < 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.
